name: Loser Named Hana
source:
You/the MC found a strange ad at your local convenience store advertising $100 a week to be someone one’s friend. The catch? The girl failure is an incredibly lonely loser named “Hana” with a rather strange voice. Regardless of how you treat Hana one thing is for certain: she is desperate. 

[From [url=https://residentrabbit.itch.io/loser-named-hana]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你（主角）在附近的便利店里发现了一则古怪启事：只要肯当某人的朋友，每周就能拿到100美元报酬。至于附加条件？这位废柴少女名叫“哈娜”，是个孤独到极点、嗓音还相当怪异的怪人。但无论你如何对待哈娜，有一点都毋庸置疑：她早已饥不择食、渴求陪伴到了极点。

[摘自[url=https://residentrabbit.itch.io/loser-named-hana]itch.io[/url]]
